spans.s:
Dūta, ‘messenger’ or envoy,' is found several times in the Rigveda and later, used metaphorically. The sūta seems to have performed the duties later assigned to the dūta.
Foot notes iii. 3, 2; vi. 8, 4; vii. 3, 3; x. 14, 12.
Av. viii. 8, 10, etc.; Satapatha brāhmaṇa, iii. 5, 1, 6; kauṣītaki upaniṣad, ii. 1, etc. The feminine form Dūtī is found in Rv. x. 108, 2, 3, in the story of Saramā's mission to the Paṇis. Dūtya, ‘mission,’ occurs in
